cells.name: Continuity and responsiveness
cells.example: T5 answers T4 directly: reintroducing products adds noise back into a failing system.
cells.limitation: T7 only echoes T6; Empiricist never answers T8's test-one-only proposal.

cells.name: Development of ideas
cells.example: T8 narrows testing to the most suspected product, a step absent from openings.
cells.limitation: T7 adds nothing new; no distinction such as irritation versus allergy ever appears.

cells.name: Exploration of central tensions
cells.example: T3 vs T4: immediate comfort against identifying the culprit to avoid repeats.
cells.limitation: Nobody raises active ingredients, patch testing or allergic versus irritant reaction; tension stays procedural.

cells.name: Integration of perspectives
cells.example: T9 folds Minimalist's T8 narrowing into the Empiricist's one-at-a-time sequence.
cells.limitation: T6 capitulates wholesale to T4; T5's skip-them-entirely option is dropped, not integrated.

cells.name: Progress toward understanding
cells.example: Section E sequences: stop, recover, test suspect first, dermatologist if persisting.
cells.limitation: Ending stays generic; user learns little beyond stop and reintroduce one by one.

cells.name: Faithful engagement
cells.example: T5 represents T4's reintroduction plan accurately before objecting to it.
cells.limitation: T3 is a weak pragmatism, comfort only, conceded immediately in T6.

cells.name: Substance of challenges
cells.example: T4 names the cost of not identifying the culprit: repeating the error.
cells.limitation: No objection names an assumption and what breaks; T5's 'noise' claim goes unanswered.

cells.name: Accuracy and support
cells.example: Section E: testing on inflamed skin is unreliable, a sound practical claim.
cells.limitation: T1 Bacon quote unmarked, translation unnamed; T7 falls under 25 words; D misstates Empiricist.

cells.name: Calibration and transparency
cells.example: Section E keeps branches conditional: if severe, if one suspected, if persists.
cells.limitation: T7 calls one-at-a-time result 'verified fact'; ignores combination effects raised later in E.

cells.name: Intellectual honesty and revision
cells.example: T6 concedes comfort is not the only metric, crediting the Empiricist.
cells.limitation: T6 reversal restates T4 without narrowing; Empiricist silently skips T8's challenge.

cells.name: Identification of the actual concern
cells.example: Section A frames relief now versus isolating the irritant for future prevention.
cells.limitation: Never asks whether user wants to keep the products or how severe the stinging is.

cells.name: Meaningful use of personal context
cells.example: T2 ties the problem to starting all three at once.
cells.limitation: No use of product types, routine order or which product is applied where.

cells.name: Fit with goals and values
cells.example: T6 links testing to the user wanting to keep using products.
cells.limitation: User's goal is assumed, not asked; T5 suggests dropping all without checking desire.

cells.name: Attention to constraints and stakes
cells.example: Section E notes testing on inflamed skin is unreliable, so recovery comes first.
cells.limitation: No recovery timeframe, no warning signs like swelling or hives needing prompt care.

cells.name: Responsiveness to information
cells.example: Section E branches on severity, a suspected product, and persistence after stopping.
cells.limitation: No direct questions; missing facts like actives, timing of sting, swelling never raised.

cells.name: Clarification of desires and motivations
cells.example: T6 surfaces one motive: wanting to keep using products.
cells.limitation: Only one motive, asserted; no alternatives such as why three were started together.

cells.name: Examination of assumptions
cells.example: T5 questions whether any of the three products is essential.
cells.limitation: Assumption that one product is the culprit stays unexamined until Section E.

cells.name: Clarification of values and priorities
cells.example: T3 vs T4 contrasts comfort now with knowledge for later.
cells.limitation: Conflict is resolved by speakers, not offered to the user to weigh.

cells.name: Recognition of fears and outside expectations
cells.example: T9 mentions minimising suffering during testing.
cells.limitation: No fear, habit or social expectation explored; T1 and T2 scold the user instead.

cells.name: Agency and reflective ownership
cells.example: T5 leaves open whether the user wants these products at all.
cells.limitation: Mostly directives ('you must stop', 'Do not test all three') rather than choosable distinctions.

cells.name: Definition of the decision and options
cells.example: Options: test all, test the suspect first, drop all, see dermatologist.
cells.limitation: Patch testing on a small skin area never offered as a limited step.

cells.name: Explanation of tradeoffs
cells.example: T8 trades thoroughness for a shorter, simpler recovery.
cells.limitation: Cost of dropping all three (losing benefits) and of testing on face never stated.

cells.name: Identification of decisive conditions
cells.example: Section E: if stinging persists after stopping all, suspect combination or environment.
cells.limitation: No observable cues for which product to suspect, nor what 'enough time' means.

cells.name: Treatment of uncertainty
cells.example: Section E separates persistent irritation from single-product reaction.
cells.limitation: Irritant versus allergic reaction, the consequential unknown, is never separated.

cells.name: Proportionate next steps
cells.example: Section E: stop all, recover, test the suspect first, dermatologist if persisting.
cells.limitation: No escalation for swelling or blistering; testing method on face left unspecified.

cells.name: Accessible language
cells.example: T9: test the most likely offender first; if fine, move to the next.
cells.limitation: T1 Bacon candle line is abstract and unexplained for a skincare question.

cells.name: Traceable arguments and references
cells.example: T6 names 'the Empiricist is right', traceable to T4.
cells.limitation: T9 'That is a useful compromise' and T7 'Precisely' rely on implicit referents.

cells.name: Manageable pacing and turn length
cells.example: Nine short turns, easy to follow in one reading.
cells.limitation: T7 falls under 25 words per deterministic check.

cells.name: Distinguishable positions and voices
cells.example: Positions distinct: isolate, strip away, relieve pain.
cells.limitation: One shared plain register; T6 shift explicit but voices otherwise interchangeable.

cells.name: Economy and sustained attention
cells.example: Section E condenses the debate into three conditional branches.
cells.limitation: T7 recaps T4; T6 restates T4's reasoning rather than advancing it.

cells.name: Meaningful stakes and tension
cells.example: T3 vs T4: stop the pain now versus repeating the error later.
cells.limitation: Low stakes framing; tension dissolves by T6.

cells.name: Surprise and reversals
cells.example: T6 Pragmatist abandons comfort-only metric, naming the Empiricist.
cells.limitation: T6 reversal restates T4 without narrowing; no new argument changed the mind.

cells.name: Personality and expressive voice
cells.example: T1 'You have created a muddle of variables' gives Bacon some bite.
cells.limitation: Minds sound alike after T1; flat expression throughout.

cells.name: Memorable delivery
cells.example: T1 candle image: method first lights the candle, then shows the way.
cells.limitation: No vivid skincare example or analogy; T7 and T9 generic.

cells.name: Anticipation and emotional movement
cells.example: T8 to T9 lands a compromise as a modest resolution.
cells.limitation: Even rhythm and register across all nine turns; little emotional movement.

strengths: Section E gives conditional branches: stop if severe, test suspect first, dermatologist if persisting.
T8 Minimalist narrows testing to the most suspected product, which T9 adopts.
T4 clearly names the cost of not identifying the culprit: repeating the reaction.
weaknesses: No skincare substance anywhere: actives, patch testing, irritant versus allergic reaction, warning signs never raised.
T6 Pragmatist reversal restates T4 without a new argument; tension collapses mid-debate.
No questions about severity, product types or goals; T1 and T2 scold the user.

symptoms.observed: Debate stays on testing procedure; no ingredient, patch test or allergy distinction raised.
symptoms.evidence: Pick the one you suspect most and observe.

symptoms.observed: No turn asks severity, product types or swelling; branches appear only in Section E.
symptoms.evidence: You have created a muddle of variables.

symptoms.observed: Reversal restates T4's claim without narrowing it or citing a new argument.
symptoms.evidence: I previously thought comfort was the only metric, but the Empiricist is right.

symptoms.observed: Empiricist echoes agreement in T7 and never answers T8's test-one-only challenge.
symptoms.evidence: Precisely. By isolating one variable at a time

symptoms.observed: No observable cue for which product to suspect or how long to wait.
symptoms.evidence: allowing enough time for the skin to react

findings.description: Turn falls under 25 words, per deterministic check.
Bacon candle line given as quotation without marks or named translation; wording resembles a known English translation.
No mention of swelling, hives or blistering as signs warranting prompt medical care.
Says Empiricist insists on thoroughness against Minimalist, but Empiricist never responds to T8.

rubric_fit_notes: Troubleshooting question with sparse user detail; C4 self-discovery cells fit loosely, rated on the opportunity offered. Bacon quote fidelity is from memory only.
question_type_note: Read as a decision about how to isolate an irritant; all cells read as written.
